generationPrompts.prompt: Use case: flat logo-brand artwork. Create one professional transparent RGBA asset sheet arranged in FOUR separate, well-spaced quadrants. Upper left is the full logo in dark ink. Upper right is the SAME full logo in uniform opaque cool silver #c4ccd0. Lower left is the compact emblem only, in dark ink. Lower right is the SAME emblem in uniform opaque cool silver #c4ccd0. Leave wide transparent gutters around all four assets so they can be extracted without overlap. All shapes are flat, solid print ink with crisp smooth edges; outside shapes is entirely transparent, with NO glow, fuzzy halo, texture, shadow, background, lighting or photographic material. The compact emblem must read clearly at 32px, with broad strokes and open counters. Keep each design inside its own quadrant. No quadrant labels. No slogans, year, contact info, claim, badge or extra wording. This is an independent unapproved dealership-logo proposal. Exact full logo words NASSEM AL SHAM, smaller USED CARS below. Compact emblem to the left: an elegant bold NS monogram formed with one rounded dark-teal ribbon crossing a sturdy vertical stem, open negative spaces and a small forward notch. Sophisticated flat dark teal #125665 and charcoal #17242b, simple sturdy contemporary lettering, balanced horizontal lockup. No car clipart, shield, crest, wave decoration or speed lines. A restrained new monogram proposal, immediately legible at 32px.
